# CR-005 — Per-tenant pipeline stages + gift-commerce preset / stage ของ pipeline แยกตาม tenant

**Status:** approved (Boss, 2026-08-09) · **Mode:** DDD
**Plan ref:** SmartGift `docs/implementation-plan-2026-08-09.md` §5 (ZUMP01 Phase 3) · **Design ref:** `smart-crm-design-2026-08-08.md` §6 (Sales Pipeline)

## Problem / ปัญหา

The lifecycle vocabulary is education-specific (`NEW → CONTACTED → INTERESTED → ENROLLED → PAID → LOST`)
and **hardcoded in at least nine places** — API validation (`customers/[id]/stage/route.js:13`),
five dashboard/CRM surfaces, `components/inbox/ProfileTab.jsx:7`,
`components/marketing/CampaignBuilder.jsx:11`, `modules/core/crm/index.js:15`, and a KPI query in
`repositories/customerRepo.js:548` that counts `lifecycleStage: 'ENROLLED'` literally.

SmartGift is gift commerce: it needs `QUOTED → NEGOTIATION → WON`, and "ENROLLED" is meaningless
to it. Today a gift-commerce tenant cannot record a quote stage at all, and its conversion KPI
would silently report **0** forever because the query looks for a stage that tenant never uses.
คำศัพท์ stage ถูก hardcode ไว้อย่างน้อย 9 จุด และ KPI นับจาก `ENROLLED` ตรงๆ — tenant ที่ไม่ใช่โรงเรียนจะได้ 0 ตลอด

## Design decision / แนวทาง

**Named presets, not free-form arrays.** `Tenant.config` is already a `Json` column used for
`vatRate/currency/timezone/brandColor` and read by the industry-plugin registry
(`modules/industry/index.js` loads on `tenant.config.industry`). CR-005 adds
`tenant.config.pipeline` = a **preset name**. A validated preset keeps the vocabulary
enumerable (so UI colours/labels/order and the KPI role mapping stay well-defined) while a
free-form array would let a typo silently break the funnel. Custom stage lists are out of scope.

**Stages carry semantic roles.** Every preset stage declares `role ∈ entry | active | quoted |
won | paid | lost`. Code that means "converted" asks for the **role**, never a literal — this is
what fixes `customerRepo.js:548` and keeps future presets from re-introducing the same bug.

## Change / การแก้

| # | Piece | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **`src/lib/pipelineStages.js`** (new — SSOT) | `PIPELINE_PRESETS` with two entries. **`education`** (DEFAULT, byte-identical to today): `NEW`(entry) `CONTACTED`(active) `INTERESTED`(active) `ENROLLED`(won) `PAID`(paid) `LOST`(lost). **`gift-commerce`**: `NEW`(entry) `CONTACTED`(active) `QUOTED`(quoted) `NEGOTIATION`(active) `WON`(won) `PAID`(paid) `LOST`(lost). Each stage: `{ key, label, labelTh, color, role }` — reuse the existing colours from `crm/page.jsx` / `crm/customers/page.jsx` so the education UI is unchanged. Exports: `resolvePipeline(tenantConfig)` → preset (unknown/absent name ⇒ `education`, never throws), `getStageKeys(preset)`, `getStageByRole(preset, role)`, `isValidStage(preset, key)`, and **`describeStage(preset, key)`** which returns a fallback descriptor `{ key, label: key, color: <neutral>, role: 'unknown', isLegacy: true }` for a value not in the preset. |
| 2 | **Legacy-value safety** | Switching a tenant's preset does **not** migrate existing `Customer.lifecycleStage` rows. Every rendering path must go through `describeStage`, so a customer still sitting on `INTERESTED` after a switch renders as a neutral legacy chip instead of crashing or vanishing from the list. No data migration in this CR. |
| 3 | **API validation** — `src/app/api/customers/[id]/stage/route.js` | Delete the module-level `VALID_STAGES`. Load the tenant (via `tenantRepo`, not `getPrisma` — repo-pattern guardrail), resolve its preset, validate against that. Error body keeps the same shape, listing the tenant's own stages. `transitionStage` + `CustomerStageHistory` + the audit + Pusher calls are **unchanged** (atomic transition is out of scope). |
| 4 | **Expose to the client** — `shapeTenantConfig` in `src/lib/repositories/tenantRepo.js` | Add `pipeline: { name, stages }` (resolved, safe to serialize — labels/colours/roles, no secrets). `GET /api/tenant/config` already feeds `TenantContext` on every dashboard load, so this is the delivery path; no new endpoint. |
| 5 | **UI de-hardcode** (6 files) | Read stages from `TenantContext` instead of local constants: `app/(dashboard)/crm/page.jsx:33` (funnel), `crm/customers/page.jsx:26` (chips), `crm/[id]/page.jsx:34` (`STAGES` — this file already consumes tenant config), `crm/segments/page.jsx:25`, `components/inbox/ProfileTab.jsx:7` (`STATUS_FLOW`), `components/marketing/CampaignBuilder.jsx:11` (`STAGE_OPTIONS`). Where a file renders a stage that is not in the preset, use `describeStage`. Keep each file's existing layout/styling — this is a data-source change, not a redesign. |
| 6 | **KPI role fix** — `src/lib/repositories/customerRepo.js:548` | `lifecycleStage: 'ENROLLED'` → the tenant preset's `won` stage key via `getStageByRole`. Any other literal-stage query found while doing this gets the same treatment (grep `lifecycleStage:` across `src/lib`). |
| 7 | **`modules/core/crm/index.js:15`** | `CRM_STATUSES` is a stale duplicate of the education list. Re-export from `pipelineStages.js` (education preset keys) and add a comment that per-tenant vocabulary comes from `resolvePipeline`, so nobody re-imports it as the SSOT. |
| 8 | **Tenant config write path** | `updateTenantConfig` must accept and validate `pipeline`: reject a name that is not a known preset with a clear error. (The tenant-admin endpoint is currently unreachable for every role — see CR-004 follow-up — so the practical way to set it today is the onboarding script; add a `--pipeline <name>` flag to `scripts/onboard/tenant-line-oa.mjs` that writes `config.pipeline`, following that script's existing explicit-fields-only rule.) |
| 9 | **Tests** | `pipelineStages` unit: default resolution, unknown name ⇒ education, role lookup per preset, `describeStage` legacy fallback. Stage route: gift-commerce tenant accepts `QUOTED`/rejects `ENROLLED`; education tenant accepts `ENROLLED`/rejects `QUOTED` (**the regression that proves existing tenants are unaffected**); transition still writes history. `shapeTenantConfig` includes the resolved pipeline. `customerRepo` KPI counts the preset's won stage (assert a gift-commerce tenant counts `WON`, not zero). `updateTenantConfig` rejects an unknown preset name. |

## Acceptance Criteria / เกณฑ์ยอมรับ

- **AC1** A tenant with no `config.pipeline` behaves exactly as before: same six stages, same
  labels/colours, same API validation errors. (Regression test required.)
- **AC2** A tenant with `config.pipeline = 'gift-commerce'` can transition a customer to `QUOTED`
  and `NEGOTIATION`; `ENROLLED` is rejected with a message listing that tenant's stages.
- **AC3** `GET /api/tenant/config` returns the resolved `pipeline.stages`, and every listed UI
  surface renders from it — no stage vocabulary remains hardcoded in those 6 files.
- **AC4** The conversion KPI counts the preset's `won` stage: non-zero for a gift-commerce tenant
  with `WON` customers (today it would be 0).
- **AC5** A customer whose stored stage is not in the tenant's current preset still renders
  (neutral legacy chip) and does not break the list, the detail page, or the funnel.
- **AC6** `npm run lint` + targeted vitest + `npm run test:scripts` green; full suite no new failures.

## Out of scope / นอกขอบเขต

Custom (non-preset) stage lists and a pipeline editor UI · migrating historical `lifecycleStage`
values when a tenant switches preset (AC5 covers display; a migration is a separate CR) ·
demo/presentation fixtures (`lib/demoData.js`, `PresentationDemoBridge.jsx`) which stay
education-flavoured · the `Quote` model and quote-aging automation (CR-007) · automation triggers
keyed on stage names.

Two write paths create a `Customer` with a `lifecycleStage` value that exists in **no** preset —
`src/lib/services/salesKpiService.js:37` filters on `'HOT_LEAD'`, and
`src/lib/repositories/conversationRepo.js:182,211` writes `'LEAD'` on webhook-created customers.
Neither is a CR-005 pipeline stage; both predate this CR and are a different, unrelated
vocabulary. Left untouched here — an auto-created customer is therefore born on a stage that
renders as a neutral legacy chip (`describeStage`'s fallback, AC5) rather than a real stage.
Flagged for a follow-up CR to either fold them into a preset role or stop using them as
`lifecycleStage` values.

## Accepted deviations / ความเบี่ยงเบนที่ยอมรับ (review fix, 2026-08-09)

`components/inbox/ProfileTab.jsx`'s stage dropdown previously used its own small, independent
(and inconsistent — e.g. CONTACTED was yellow, INTERESTED was blue) per-key colour map, unrelated
to the colours `crm/page.jsx`'s funnel or `crm/customers/page.jsx`'s badges used for the same
stage keys. It now follows the SSOT's `chipBg`/`chipText` pair like every other chip surface, so
its stage hues **change** (CONTACTED is now blue, INTERESTED yellow, ENROLLED purple, PAID
green — matching the rest of the app) while contrast is preserved (light bg / dark text pair, not
the funnel chart's mid-tone `color` used as text). Accepted deliberately for cross-surface
consistency rather than preserving ProfileTab's original one-off palette.

## Rollout / การปล่อย

No schema change (`Tenant.config` already exists). Default preset means zero behaviour change
until a tenant is explicitly switched, so this can merge ahead of SmartGift's own switch. Set
SmartGift's preset with the onboarding script's new `--pipeline gift-commerce` flag.
